sentences.en: My sister is majoring in developmental psychology.
sentences.zh: 我姐姐主修发展心理学。

sentences.en: The company has launched a new program to support developmental needs of employees.
sentences.zh: 公司启动了一个新项目来支持员工的发展需求。

sentences.en: Children's books often focus on themes related to developmental milestones and growth.
sentences.zh: 儿童书籍常常关注与成长里程碑和发育相关的主题。

senses.zh: 发展的，开发的；促使成长的
